# Loment 0.1.5

The 0.1.5 milestone is closed: **167 of its 173 issues are done**. The six still open are the
`loment/lspe/` packaging split (tracked for 0.1.5.1), not defects.

This release is mostly about turning promises into artifacts you can inspect: `choose` is a
seven-dimension matrix whose every legal cell is compiled by both implementations and compared byte
for byte; the gate names every criterion it exempts; and the bootstrap root now carries a
provenance record that a rebuild can falsify.

## Install

| Asset | |
|---|---|
| `loment-0.1.5-linux-x64.tar.gz` | Linux x86-64. Unpack anywhere; `bin/loment` is the launcher. |
| `loment-0.1.5-windows-x64.zip` | Windows x86-64. Unzip and run `install.cmd`. |
| `loment-0.1.5-windows-x64-setup.exe` | Windows x86-64, self-extracting. Double-click. |
| `loment-skill.zip` | The agent guide (`SKILL.md`) on its own, for people who want only that. |
| `SHA256SUMS` · `SHA256SUMS.asc` · `FINGERPRINT` | Checksums, a detached signature, and the key fingerprint. The installers verify the payload before copying anything. |

Installing and running needs **no Python, no clang and no WSL** — native binaries plus the standard
library.

## new · `choose` is a matrix, and the gate walks it

`choose` now has seven dimensions — `mode`, `gc`, `runtime`, `port`, `vm`, `lms`, `lspe` — and the
gate covers the whole legal matrix rather than a sample: every legal cell is compiled by the
reference and the self-hosted compiler and the IR must be identical, while the artifact-level rows
are judged on the linked image (`loment_choose_matrix_test`, 17 criteria).

The `mode` row became a real layer instead of a word:

- **The hosted layer is named.** `docs/275` defines it against the world-port table: `std` may carry
  hosted names (`libc` / filesystem / threads / time / network), `no_std` may not.
- **`std` + `hosted` links the real `libc.so.6` and runs**; a `no_std` image carries no hosted
  symbols; both front ends refuse `no_std` + `hosted`; and the IR itself declares the row, so the
  linker can check a claim it did not write (`; loment-mode: no_std` against
  `; loment-port: hosted`).
- **`no_gc` is accepted and checked the same way**: the artifact says “no collector”, and the linker
  fails it if a collector is in the image.

## new · the gate says what it skips

- **Per-criterion baseline.** The known-red list names a criterion, not a suite; `*` is reserved for
  a suite that crashes before naming anything. Budgets are checked against the base branch, not only
  against themselves: a PR cannot lower a floor or add a skip.
- **The capacity ratchet scans the whole tree** (`loment/**`, recursive) and covers two classes it
  used to miss: literal bounds (`while j < 200`) and fixed-size arrays (`[u32; 16]`). Every silent
  capacity either gains a guard or is explained by name.
- **An independent oracle for the native surface.** `loment_spec_oracle_test` derives expected
  values from a pure-Python model of `docs/144` §3, so a criterion can fail when *both*
  implementations are wrong in the same way — the case a twin criterion cannot see.
- **A falsifiable bootstrap root.** `loment/build/genesis/provenance.json` binds the committed
  genesis to its seed, the mirror IR and the toolchain; `--check` catches a stale root and
  `--verify` rebuilds it.
- **10 shards, 90 suites, 1206 criteria** — with the shard table measured from real runs instead of
  guessed.

## new · runtime, threads, LVM

- **Real threads carry a concurrency model**: a global allocation lock (owner-tid reentrant) around
  `alloc` / `free` / the root cursor, and the collector defers entirely once a thread has been
  spawned (`docs/245` §10). The criterion runs 4 threads × 1500 rounds and checks for duplicate or
  torn blocks; the thread program's IR is byte-identical between the two compilers.
- **LVM** ships its interpreter and compact form with the toolchain: T0 through T3, the 6.1× T2
  baseline, and the compact form measured in `docs/250` / `docs/251`. The gate includes stability
  (no tier hangs, five refusals named) and a performance ceiling with a deterministic criterion.
- **LibL / LibC** link real libraries: system `.so` (V2) and static `.a` (V1), IFUNC and `STT_NOTYPE`
  imports, `-fPIC` objects (`GOTPCREL`), TLS relocations, section headers for `objdump`/`readelf`,
  `PT_GNU_RELRO`, and constructors. The reference linker and the self-hosted mirror produce
  byte-identical products on the same inputs.

## fix · the 0.1.5 defect sweep

**All 134 bug-labelled issues in the milestone are closed**, and every fix that changed behaviour
carries a criterion that was red before it and green after. The recurring shape was *silence*, not
crashes:

- **State-slot collisions inside the self-hosted compiler.** `match` arm labels overwrote the GC
  tier flag (`#719`); the emitter's new diagnostic slot overwrote the `thread_spawn` flag, which
  surfaced as a bogus “more than 20 arguments” error on a thread probe. Both now have their own
  slots, pinned by criteria.
- **Fixed tables that corrupted instead of refusing.** The checker's name environment had no bound
  (2048 bytes = 256 entries) — 515 `let`s in one function segfaulted on Linux and silently wrote
  through on PE. It is now 4096 entries and stops at the cap; the emitter's tables gained guards
  (`PT_EMAX`, `PT_FMAX`, `PT_GLRMX`).
- **Crashes replaced by diagnostics.** The self-hosted lexer no longer reads past a full token
  buffer (the old guard was non-monotonic), the parser's nesting limits are one left-to-right pass
  over `(` / `[` / `{` plus unary chains, and `lomadmit` reports an oversized input instead of
  truncating. `loment_crash_test` drives the real driver in all nine cases.
- **Formatter twins.** Comments inside a multi-line `||` expression were attributed to different
  lines by the two formatters; a criterion now compares every corpus file byte for byte.
- **Security.** `free` scrubs the payload before reuse; `http_req_build` rejects CR/LF/NUL;
  installers verify every file they copy, invoke PowerShell by absolute path, and refuse to install
  without a verifier; the release publishes a detached signature; `lompi` pins the registry index
  out of band and quotes package-controlled paths.
- **lompi's network layer** is the `internet` package now — `net_tcp4` / `net_send` / `net_recv` /
  `net_hdr_end` are gone, and the header-end logic is checked against a CPython oracle rather than
  against a second copy of itself.

## known boundaries

- **LSPE ships.** The `lspe` dimension, the evidence ledger and the site census are in the tree
  (`docs/262`), and a release build accepts `choose lspe_*` — the last channel gate opened for
  0.1.5. Likewise `lms` ships at `lms_full` by default (`docs/270`): the safe memory manager's
  seven levels are present, not a dev-only glimpse.
- **The six open 0.1.5 issues** are the `loment/lspe/` packaging split, not defects.
- **`no_std` enforcement** covers the mode/hosted row and the linker check; a library writing
  `choose` is a loader rule, and full capability-chain reporting for `no_std` remains #536.
